details.description:
Introducing the Get-A-Way Mango Vanilla Ice Cream Duet — a tropical frozen delight that brings together the rich, authentic taste of ripe Indian mangoes with a smooth, creamy vanilla ice cream centre. Each 60ml bar features a luscious mango outer layer made with real mango pulp (21%), wrapped around a protein-packed vanilla ice cream core that melts beautifully in every bite. Crafted for those who love indulging without guilt, the Mango Vanilla Duet is made with zero added sugar, making it an ideal treat for health-conscious consumers, those watching their sugar intake, and mango lovers who refuse to compromise on flavour. With just 97.34 kcal per serving and 5g of protein, it is one of the most nutritious frozen desserts available in the market today. The outer mango layer uses fructooligosaccharides and real fruit pulp for natural sweetness, while the inner vanilla ice cream is made with whey protein concentrate and erythritol — a natural, low-calorie sweetener that replaces refined sugar. Together, they create an experience that is tropical, refreshing, and completely satisfying.
Get-A-Way was born from a belief that healthy and delicious should not be mutually exclusive. Featured on Shark Tank India and trusted by thousands of customers across the country, the brand brings you a dessert that tastes as indulgent as it looks but with a fraction of the sugar and calories. Vegetarian, made in India, and bursting with the taste of summer.
